<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#1C1E21"/>
  
  <!-- status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="27" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">9:41</text>
    <line x1="310" y1="20" x2="310" y2="25" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="315" y1="18" x2="315" y2="25" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="320" y1="16" x2="320" y2="25" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="325" y1="14" x2="325" y2="25" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="342" cy="21" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="338" y1="21" x2="346" y2="21" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="356" y="15" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="359" y="18" width="16" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
    <rect x="379" y="19" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
  </g>

  <!-- hero image panel -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="44" width="390" height="442" fill="#303438"/>
    <rect x="0" y="44" width="390" height="442" fill="#50545B" opacity="0.3"/>
    <circle cx="300" cy="130" r="48" fill="#F4B740" opacity="0.9"/>
    <polygon points="0,386 92,276 150,332 213,246 390,409 390,486 0,486" fill="#3C6468"/>
    <polygon points="0,423 120,330 188,382 258,302 390,426 390,486 0,486" fill="#294649"/>
    <polygon points="0,456 68,398 135,430 204,375 273,431 334,385 390,430 390,486 0,486" fill="#1C2B30"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="486" x2="390" y2="486" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="4"/>
    <rect x="20" y="66" width="105" height="28" rx="6" fill="#1C1E21" opacity="0.72"/>
    <circle cx="38" cy="80" r="5" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="51" y="85" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">NEWS TODAY</text>
    <rect x="22" y="442" width="142" height="28" rx="6" fill="#1C1E21" opacity="0.78"/>
    <text x="34" y="461" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Stories that matter</text>
  </g>

  <!-- copy panel -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="532" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="24px" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Stay informed,</text>
    <text x="24" y="562" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="24px" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">your way</text>
    <text x="24" y="594" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Discover the latest stories and perspectives</text>
    <text x="24" y="616" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">from the topics you care about most.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- progress indicators -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="166" cy="650" r="7" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <circle cx="185" cy="650" r="7" fill="#A0A3BD"/>
    <circle cx="204" cy="650" r="7" fill="#A0A3BD"/>
  </g>

  <!-- controls -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="679" width="85" height="50" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="66.5" y="710" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Back</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="281" y="679" width="85" height="50" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="323.5" y="710" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#FFFFFF">Next</text>
    <polyline points="333,700 339,705 333,710" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="756" width="390" height="88" fill="#25282C"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="756" x2="390" y2="756" stroke="#3A3B3C" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <!-- explore -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="48" cy="781" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <polygon points="52,777 49,785 41,788 44,780" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
      <text x="48" y="813" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Explore</text>
    </g>
    <!-- bookmarks -->
    <g>
      <rect x="121" y="772" width="14" height="19" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <polygon points="124,787 128,784 132,787 132,773 124,773" fill="#B0B3B8" opacity="0.85"/>
      <text x="128" y="813" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Saved</text>
    </g>
    <!-- home active -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="195,778 207,768 219,778" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <rect x="199" y="777" width="16" height="14" rx="2" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <rect x="205" y="782" width="5" height="9" fill="#25282C"/>
      <text x="207" y="813" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#1877F2">Home</text>
    </g>
    <!-- profile -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="335" cy="776" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <ellipse cx="335" cy="789" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="335" y="813" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
